remarks: This spacious 1-bedroom, 1.5-bath condo offers 1,057 square feet of comfortable, well-designed living space. The expansive 30-foot living room flows seamlessly to a screened-in balcony-perfect for relaxing-and a dining area that easily accommodates eight guests. You'll love the beautiful parquet floors throughout, along with generous storage, including a 12-foot-wide closet and a walk-in closet in the bedroom. The kitchen and both bathrooms have been tastefully updated, making this home move-in ready. Regency Towers is ideally located across from the Tully Health Center and just a short walk to Stamford's vibrant downtown, filled with shops, restaurants, and entertainment. Plus, you'll enjoy easy access to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, Metro-North, local beaches, and more. The HOA includes 24/7 door staff, an on-site superintendent, updated security systems, garage parking, and utilities-heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Laundry facilities are conveniently located on every floor. This is a wonderful opportunity to live in one of Stamford's most sought-after buildings-don't miss it!
